name: Expert_AH_HM_Stoch
summary: This EA uses a custom Stochastic oscillator signal filter (CH_HM_Stoch) combined with a moving average to generate buy/sell signals within the MQL5 Expert Advisor framework. It employs fixed lot sizing for money management and no trailing stop. Trade entries and exits are governed by configurable signal threshold values for opening and closing positions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义的随机振荡器信号过滤器(CH_HM_Stoch)结合移动平均线来生成买卖信号，基于MQL5标准专家框架运行。采用固定手数资金管理方式，无追踪止损。交易的入场和出场由可配置的信号阈值控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于自定义的CH_HM_Stoch信号过滤器，它融合了随机振荡器(Stochastic)和移动平均线(MA)两个指标。入场条件是当Stochastic指标值与MA的交叉或偏离超过设定的开仓阈值(Signal_ThresholdOpen=40)时触发交易信号。出场条件是当信号强度低于平仓阈值(Signal_ThresholdClose=20)时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式(Money_FixLot_Lots=0.1)，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理使用CMoneyFixedLot类，按固定比例(Money_FixLot_Percent=10%)和固定手数进行交易。该策略属于均值回归类型，利用Stochastic的超买超卖特性结合MA趋势判断寻找价格回归机会。未设置止损和止盈(Signal_StopLevel=0, Signal_TakeLevel=0)，风险控制完全依赖信号过滤器的平仓逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the custom CH_HM_Stoch signal filter, which integrates the Stochastic oscillator with a Moving Average (MA) indicator. Entry conditions are triggered when the Stochastic indicator value crosses or deviates from the MA beyond the configured opening threshold (Signal_ThresholdOpen=40). Exit conditions occur when the signal strength falls below the closing threshold (Signal_ThresholdClose=20). Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach (Money_FixLot_Lots=0.1) without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management employs the CMoneyFixedLot class, trading with a fixed percentage (Money_FixLot_Percent=10%) and fixed lot size. The strategy falls under the mean reversion category, leveraging the overbought/oversold characteristics of the Stochastic combined with MA trend assessment to identify price reversion opportunities. Notably, no explicit Stop Loss or Take Profit levels are set (Signal_StopLevel=0, Signal_TakeLevel=0), relying entirely on the signal filter's closing logic for risk control.

pros: 基于标准MQL5 Expert框架开发，代码结构清晰规范，易于维护和扩展
Stochastic结合MA的信号过滤机制可以有效过滤虚假信号，提高入场质量
采用信号阈值控制开平仓，提供了灵活的策略调优空间
挂单设有过期时间(Signal_Expiration=4)，避免长时间挂单占用保证金
pros_en: Built on the standard MQL5 Expert framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
The Stochastic combined with MA signal filtering mechanism can effectively filter out false signals and improve entry quality
Signal threshold-based entry/exit control provides flexible strategy tuning space
Pending orders have expiration time (Signal_Expiration=4 bars), preventing long-term margin occupation
cons: 未设置止损(Signal_StopLevel=0)和止盈(Signal_TakeLevel=0)，在信号失效时缺乏硬性风险保护
采用固定手数交易，无法根据市场波动性和账户风险动态调整仓位大小
D线周期设为49远大于常规参数(通常3-5)，可能导致信号严重滞后，错过最佳入场时机
无追踪止损机制(TrailingNone)，盈利仓位无法锁定浮动利润
仅依赖单一信号过滤器，缺乏多维度确认，在震荡市中可能频繁产生错误信号
cons_en: No Stop Loss (Signal_StopLevel=0) or Take Profit (Signal_TakeLevel=0) set, lacking hard risk protection when signals fail
Fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust position size based on market volatility and account risk
The D-period is set to 49, far exceeding conventional values (typically 3-5), which may cause severe signal lag and missed optimal entry timing
No trailing stop mechanism (TrailingNone), profitable positions cannot lock in floating profits
Relies on a single signal filter without multi-dimensional confirmation, potentially generating frequent false signals in choppy markets
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数的非零默认值，提供基本的风险保护底线
将固定手数替换为动态仓位管理(如ATR-based或风险百分比模式)，根据市场波动自适应调整
引入追踪止损机制替代TrailingNone，以在趋势行情中锁定利润并让利润奔跑
improvements_en: Add non-zero default values for Stop Loss and Take Profit parameters to provide a baseline risk protection floor
Replace fixed lot sizing with dynamic position management (e.g., ATR-based or risk-percentage mode) for market-volatility-adaptive adjustment
Introduce a trailing stop mechanism to replace TrailingNone, enabling profit locking in trending markets while letting profits run

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，在极端行情下可能造成巨大亏损且无硬性平仓保护
固定手数模式不随账户规模调整，在小账户中可能导致过度杠杆
Stochastic D线周期49过长，信号滞后可能在快速反转行情中导致严重损失
risk_points_en: Stop Loss and Take Profit are both 0, which could cause massive losses in extreme market conditions with no hard exit protection
Fixed lot mode does not adjust with account size, potentially leading to over-leveraging in small accounts
Stochastic D-period of 49 is excessively long; signal lag may cause severe losses during rapid market reversals

It employs fixed lot sizing for money management and no trailing stop. Trade entries and exits are governed by configurable signal threshold values for opening and closing positions.
